b: I’ve always used a normal deadblow for my chisels and figured it was time I finally made my own. Laminated the head and with a piece of pvc as a spacer for the through handle. First time messing with marquetry, if this qualifies for it that is. Next time I’d probably build the handle out a little bit to shape in a wider end. Any other pointers, or changes you make would be appreciated.
